priorityList: Apply Instant Poison and always start combat from Stealth.
Spend combo points when you have at least (Max - 1), or (Max - 2) if you are Fatebound and Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Adrenaline Rush if it is not active and you are not currently at your combo point spending threshold.
Cast Roll the Bones if you have no buffs or only one buff active.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 3 or more Roll the Bones buffs, or 2 buffs if their remaining duration is shorter than the Adrenaline Rush cooldown.
Maintain Slice and Dice at all times, prioritized as your first finisher if it is down.
Use Between the Eyes as your primary finisher whenever available.
Cast Killing Spree as a finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher, or as a builder if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Dispatch as your filler finisher when other finishers are not prioritized or available.
Use Ambush as your primary generator when Audacity or Hidden Opportunity is active.
Use Pistol Shot with Opportunity procs, prioritizing use when at maximum stacks or when you have a large combo point deficit.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you have no active Audacity or Opportunity procs.
Cast Blade Rush when energy is low to assist with regeneration.
Use Sinister Strike as your basic filler generator when no other procs are available.
